info.name: Stream Chat API (Server-side REST) Application Channels API

items.docs: Query the channels a user has access to, using a filter, sort, and pagination. Returns channel state including members, messages, reads, and channel configuration.

params.name: type
params.description: The channel type, e.g. messaging, livestream, team, gaming, commerce.

params.name: id
params.description: The channel id, unique within the channel type.
